transcript.text:
Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diesis años.
Vivo en Chicago con mi familia. Mi hermano
se llama Luis y el es muy comico. Mi gusta
jugar futbol pero no me gusta la tarea.

evidence.quote: Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diesis años.
evidence.observation: Provides basic biographical information—name and age—consistent with the Novice Mid ability to supply limited information on simple forms and documents.

evidence.quote:
Vivo en Chicago con mi familia. Mi hermano
se llama Luis y el es muy comico. Mi gusta
jugar futbol pero no me gusta la tarea.
evidence.observation: Communicates simple information about residence, family, and likes and dislikes, fitting the Novice function of conveying simple messages on familiar everyday topics.

findings.ceiling_reason: The sample does not show the Novice High functions of meeting practical writing needs through a short message, note, or list, or expressing a simple message within a learned context. It provides only a brief self-description in response to the assignment, with no demonstrated practical message or note.

evidence.quote: Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diesis años.
evidence.observation: Uses familiar formulaic language and a basic sentence to give personal information. The misspelling “diesis” shows an error in spelling.

evidence.quote:
Mi hermano
se llama Luis y el es muy comico.
evidence.observation: Conveys familiar information with basic vocabulary and sentence structure, but omits the accent in “él” and “cómico.”

evidence.quote:
Mi gusta
jugar futbol pero no me gusta la tarea.
evidence.observation: Uses familiar vocabulary and a simple contrast to communicate preferences, but “Mi gusta” shows an error in a basic structure and “futbol” lacks an accent.

findings.ceiling_reason: The sample does not show consistently accurate language even on familiar personal topics: “Mi gusta” has an incorrect pronoun form, “diesis” is misspelled, and “el,” “comico,” and “futbol” lack required accents. The descriptors’ Novice Mid accuracy concerns well-rehearsed familiar topics; the sample does not show the accuracy and control needed to support the next sublevel, Novice High.

evidence.quote: Vivo en Chicago con mi familia.
evidence.observation: The writer addresses familiar, directly personal everyday content by stating where he lives and who he lives with, consistent with Novice High content focused on common elements of daily life.

evidence.quote:
Mi hermano
se llama Luis y el es muy comico.
evidence.observation: The writer adds familiar family information, describing a brother and giving a personal characterization.

evidence.quote:
Mi gusta
jugar futbol pero no me gusta la tarea.
evidence.observation: The writer addresses personal likes and dislikes on familiar topics.

findings.ceiling_reason: The sample does not show the broader range of personal and social topics described at Intermediate, such as daily routines, common events, or other personal topics beyond basic self-introduction, family, and preferences.

evidence.quote: Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diesis años.
evidence.observation: This is a simple sentence conveying basic personal information, consistent with sentence-level writing on a familiar topic.

evidence.quote:
Vivo en Chicago con mi familia. Mi hermano
se llama Luis y el es muy comico. Mi gusta
jugar futbol pero no me gusta la tarea.
evidence.observation: The sample combines several simple sentences into a short, loosely connected text about familiar daily-life topics; it does not sustain more developed paragraph-length discourse.

findings.ceiling_reason: The sample does not show sustained sentence-level writing across the full response: it is a short set of simple sentences and does not develop connected paragraph-length text, which would be needed to show the next sublevel, Intermediate Low, on text type.

placement.rationale: The sample is consistent with Novice Mid overall. It supplies basic biographical information and conveys simple ideas about family and preferences, but does not demonstrate the practical writing functions described for Novice High, such as a short message, note, or list. Accuracy also shows errors in familiar language, while the content and text type are consistent with Novice High evidence. F is therefore the limiting criterion.
placement.caveat: One writing sample cannot establish an ACTFL rating.

drills.title: Un mensaje para un amigo
drills.instructions_es: Escribe un mensaje corto a un amigo. Dile cómo estás, qué haces hoy y qué quieres hacer con tu amigo. Usa frases sencillas. Escribe 4–6 oraciones.
drills.teacher_note_en: Targets F: practice a practical short message in a familiar social context, rather than another self-description. Look for whether the student completes the communicative task with a simple message and relevant information; do not require paragraph-level organization.
drills.targets_gap: The sample provides only a brief self-description and does not demonstrate a practical short message or note.

drills.title: Notas y listas útiles
drills.instructions_es: Completa estas tareas con palabras o frases cortas: 1) Escribe una lista de tres cosas para llevar a la escuela. 2) Escribe una nota a tu familia: «Llego a casa a las ___.» 3) Escribe un mensaje corto: «¿Quieres ___ conmigo?»
drills.teacher_note_en: Targets F through repeated practice of Novice High functions: producing a simple list, a note, and a short message. Check that each response serves the stated practical purpose and includes usable information, not just copied biographical facts.
drills.targets_gap: The sample does not demonstrate practical writing functions such as a short message, note, or list.
